about_the_game:
This collection includes a variety of a vampiric castle music tracks to fill your games with even more catchy yet haunting gothic melodies. It features a total of 12 different tracks to cover the many different areas of your games. Various music themes for different situations.

 

Each music track (except one) is between 1 and 3 minutes, with nearly 20 minutes of unique music for your games. Also it's cheaper than the first!

 

The perfect choice of music for you to get this Halloween!

Here's what I imagined each track. Let me know if you also did:

 

 

01 - Castle Buried In the Snow: A vampire hunter walking towards the ruins of an ancient castle amidst a terrible blizzard. A castle where a glorious battle once took place.

 

02 - Warm Chant: Ideal for the only cozy place you'd find in a cursed castle, where a strange and eccentric merchant offers you a moment of respite.

 

03 - Crimson Tears: Inspired by so ravenous a vampire lady that it predated Dracula himself. The one track that screams "Time to slay some vampires!"

 

04 - Petrified Poetry: A garden of eternal beauty made stone without a sculptor. The artist, mad. The statues in a silent scream, for only they know they are not statues.

 

05 - Moonlit Flight: With your newfound powers, you reach an elegant but broken stairway to the highest castle floors. You can now traverse it, fly!

 

06 - Misery: Melancholic and longing song fitting one of the main characters you may devise. Misery and a hint of malice inspired this roughly rocky song.

 

07 - Fake Muse: Memories spinning in an everlasting dance of haunted elegance. A ballroom, perhaps, filled with ethereal forms. Where does the music come from? Will you become part of this scene?

 

08 - Final Prayer: Made for the final confrontation between good and evil, at the pinnacle of the dark castle. Tragic yet inevitable.

 

09 - Immaculate: Choirs that scream "save room" or "prologue".

 

10 - Timeless Nobility: Music that would fit an enchanted art gallery. Something that never decays or grows. Perennial like an idea.

 

11 - Fathomless Interpretation left without Applause: A sublime play for nobody, rehearsed endlessly and witnessed by no one, like apparitions in a ghostly theatre.

 

12 - Bonus: Dawn of the Night: A slow version of Swirling Darkness from the first music pack, inspired by old Horror movies - hence the swan lake at the end

-----------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
